introHtml: Personal care items with handles offer practical portability for your branded giveaways. Whether you are assembling hygiene kits for trade shows or employee wellness packages, a sturdy handle makes distribution and daily use more convenient. Products like the Ike™ Tote or 22" Elite Travel Duffle combine storage with easy carrying, while the Power Clip Jumbo adds a hanging option. These items keep your logo visible and your recipients organized.
